messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 26):
"""
The definition of profit margin should be taken as the present value of net profits to the p.v of premiums. Please specify assumptions made in each scenario. For terms less than or equal to one year loss ratio may be used and for terms more than one year, profit margin may be used.] 8.37 Risk discount rate used in the profit margin 8.38 Average Sum Insured Assumed 8.39 Assumptions made under pessimistic scenario 8.40 Assumptions made under optimistic scenario 8.41 Age [PM: Profit Margin/Loss Ratio] [Age Band may be revisited based on the product design parameters] PM (base scenario) PM (pessimistic scenario) PM (optimistic scenario) S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) >=0<=2 >=3<=15 >=16<=25 >=26<=30 >=31<=35 >=36<=40 >=41<=45 >=46<=50 >=51<=55 >=56<=60 >=61<=65 >=66 Section IX: Enclosures to Form IRDAI-HIP The following specimen documents should be enclosed:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
